comment: Spec blocks dfo-apis's offline Search engine answers over the fixture graph and coverage of its tests/engine/test_resubmit_open_role.py (DAC1 totals and bilateral ODA for the United States, France, the United Arab Emirates, DAC countries' total and the multilaterals' total; DAC2a ODA to Kenya from the United States, France and official donors), each with the resubmit planner.agent.compile_whole posts for the part's whole over every donor (`posted`: the part's base identity without origin, the provider choice as a carried entry, every other choice as an explicit one) and Search's answer to it (`whole`). `dac1` is ODA from the United States in 2019, DAC1 total ODA on grant equivalents; its whole binds DAC countries' total with the DAC members listed. `dac1_non_dac` is the same for the United Arab Emirates, outside those members. `dac1_bilateral_uncovered` is the US part switched to bilateral ODA (aid type 1015) where DAC countries' total holds no bilateral ODA series, so Search drops the carried provider entry and counts the whole on total ODA. `dac2a` is ODA from the United States to Kenya in 2019, DAC2a net; its whole binds no donor, offers no provider axis and drops the carried provider entry.
